Art fair finds

13 makers from the fair at Bde Maka Ska, October 11, 2026. Each photo is a piece you picked from the artist’s own site or shop.

Painting

Marlo Graham

Acrylic paintings and digital art

Loud, thick-outlined pop art: candy-colored skylines, heaps of dice, piles of cassettes. The pink booth.

WebsiteInstagramEmail

Painting

Anna Shikany Stark

Self-taught oil painter

Paints the nostalgic stuff she collects, like Pogs, Pez dispensers and trolls, often in ornate thrift-store frames. Also at A.M.F. Gallery in Minneapolis and Cream of the Crop in Hudson, WI.

WebsiteInstagramEmail

Illustration

James Powell

Illustration and posters

The grinning teal sloth. Character illustrations, posters and a dinosaur series. His sign was his business card.

WebsiteInstagram

Illustration

Glen Arthur Lowry

Screen prints

Hand-pulled screen prints of animal characters with attitude: punk raccoons, bandit foxes, a no-hands T. rex. He also does framing.

Print shopInstagram

Illustration

Miranda Hoover

Illustration and storytelling

Children’s-book style illustration: piles of bunnies, gnomes, sea monsters and character sheets.

Illustration

Linh T Vo

Prints, stickers and suncatchers

Cheerful illustrated prints, magnets and rainbow suncatchers, from flower-crowned tigers to a pickle pizza. Her card looked like a phone profile screen.

Ceramics

Earthen Joy

Joy O’Conner, ceramicist

Stacked ceramic bead earrings and necklaces, plus speckled vessels with colorful blobs. Studio in the Q.Arma Artist Building, 1224 Quincy St NE #130.

ShopInstagram

Handmade pottery

Mugs, teacups and bowls with flowing glazes and carved or painted flowers and fruit. You got her thank-you card, so you may have bought something.
